name: Goi ca nhech
summary: A salad of nhệch, the home dish of the Kim Sơn coast. Visitors also eat it in the old capital at Hoa Lư.
origin: Kim Sơn, the same coast as Phát Diệm.
where: Kim Sơn, on the coast near Phát Diệm.
seoTitle: Goi ca nhech — Kim Son fish salad
seoDescription: Gỏi cá nhệch, the fish salad of the Kim Sơn coast in Ninh Bình.
